mapper.select: select pa.plm_attachment_id, pa.plm_id, pa.plm_attachment_category, pa.document_name, pa.description, pa.make_up, pa.document_id, pa.plm_type, pa.source_id, pa.change_iq, pa.postloan_inspection_id, (select wm_concat(fat.file_name) from fnd_atm_attachment fat, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam where fat.attachment_id = faam.attachment_id and faam.table_name = 'POSTLOAN_INSPECTION_ATTACHMENT' and faam.table_pk_value = pa.plm_attachment_id ) file_name from plm_attachment pa where pa.postloan_inspection_id = #{postloanInspectionId}
mapper.update: update plm_attachment pa set pa.change_delete='DELETE' where pa.plm_attachment_id = #{plmAttachmentId}
